text: {"memo": "Nike, Inc. (NKE) delivered a robust performance in its most recent fiscal year ending May 31, 2024 (FY2024). Revenue rose 11% to $51.2 billion, outpacing the $46.2 billion recorded in FY2023 and reflecting a multi‑year acceleration from $44.5 billion in FY2022 and $42.8 billion in FY2021. Gross margin held steady at roughly 55%, while operating margin improved to about 10% from 9% in FY2023, supporting a net income gain to $5.0 billion (≈$3.70 EPS) versus $4.0 billion ($2.90 EPS) a year earlier. Operating cash flow strengthened to $7.0 billion in FY2024, with free cash flow near $5 billion, compared with $5.5 billion operating cash flow and $3 billion free cash flow in FY2023. The company’s balance sheet remained solid, with cash and equivalents of $7.5 billion and total debt around $9 billion, yielding a modest net cash position. Guidance for FY2025 anticipates mid‑single‑digit revenue growth and margin expansion, driven by continued digital transformation, direct‑to‑consumer strength, and strategic partnerships. Overall, Nike shows resilient top‑line growth, improving profitability, and healthy cash generation, though valuation remains premium relative to peers. Our view: NKE retains strong brand momentum and cash‑flow generation, but investors should weigh the higher multiple against growth expectations."}
